summary: Eligible new Google Cloud customers get a $300 Welcome credit for covered services during a 90-day trial from signup. You must not have previously used the trial or been a paying Google Cloud, Google Maps Platform or Firebase user. A valid payment method is required for verification, but the trial does not automatically charge you; charges begin only after a manual paid-account upgrade. The trial restricts GPUs, Marketplace and third-party generative AI models. For billing accounts opened after March 2, 2026, Welcome credits cannot pay for Gemini API or AI Studio usage. Credits remain limited to covered services and the original 90-day window even after upgrading.
claim_steps: Sign in with or create a Google account.
Confirm you have not previously used the Free Trial or been a paying Google Cloud, Google Maps Platform or Firebase user.
Complete signup and payment-method/identity verification to create a Free Trial billing account; the trial does not automatically charge you.
Use the $300 credits within 90 days on covered services. GPUs, Marketplace and third-party generative AI models are restricted during the trial.
Do not budget Welcome credits for Gemini API or AI Studio if your billing account was opened after March 2, 2026; those uses are excluded.
Upgrade manually only if you want paid access; excluded services or usage beyond your remaining credit and free limits can then be charged.
